notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: This is where you'll decide what the application notifies you about and how.

profile.heading: Profile of {firstName} {lastName}
profile.intro: This is your personal profile page. Here you can find your personal data.

plugin.overviewIntro: A plugin connects an external system to Green Ecolution. It can write data and bring its own view. Select a plugin to manage its permissions and access.

install.title: Install plugin
install.description: Connects an external system to Green Ecolution and issues it an API credential.
install.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Also used as the provenance tag on imported data, and cannot be changed afterwards.
install.targetProxiedHint: Host and port of the internal service, e.g. plugin-backend:8080.
install.permissionsHint: These are the rights the plugin itself may use when it writes data into Green Ecolution.
install.accessPermissionsHint: Who may open the plugin's view. Starts out mirroring the plugin's own rights; the first change made here ends that mirroring for good. A view with action buttons hands the plugin's rights to whoever operates it — loosen these rights only deliberately.
install.slugInvalid: Only lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, not at the start or end.
install.slugReserved: The slug "{slug}" is reserved by the plugin api and cannot be used.
install.targetInvalidUrl: That is not a valid address.
install.targetRequiresHttps: The external address must use https (localhost excepted).
install.targetMatchesAppOrigin: The address must not be this application's own origin.
install.targetInvalidPort: The port must be between 1 and 65535.

keyDialog.installedDescription: Copy the key and store it wherever the plugin needs it.
keyDialog.rotatedDescription: The previous key is invalid from now on. Replace it everywhere the plugin uses it.
keyDialog.activationHint: The plugin starts out disabled. While it is, Green Ecolution rejects its adapter even with a valid key. Enable it on the detail page before you hand the key over.

detail.rotateConfirmDescription: The current key becomes invalid immediately. Update it wherever the plugin needs it.
detail.enableHint: A disabled plugin can no longer authenticate or write any data.
detail.uninstallConfirmDescription: {name} will be removed. The records it has already imported stay in Green Ecolution, but the link between them and the plugin is lost. If the same plugin is installed again later, it will not recognise those records and will import everything a second time.

toast.saveFailed: The plugin could not be saved.
toast.rotateFailed: The key could not be rotated.
toast.uninstallFailed: The plugin could not be uninstalled.
toast.installFailed: The plugin could not be installed.

view.proxiedNotice: This plugin is embedded internally through a proxy. Its view cannot be shown here yet.
view.unsafeOriginNotice: This plugin's view is served from the same address as Green Ecolution and therefore cannot be displayed. A plugin has to be reachable under its own domain.

members.profileHint: This information is used to assign people to watering plans.
members.wateringPlanSelectableHint: Only marked people appear in the selection of members linked to a watering plan.
members.rolesHint: Roles take effect immediately. A change doesn't need saving.
members.organizationHint: A person belongs to at most one organization. A change moves them immediately.
members.selfOrganizationLocked: Your own organization can't be changed here. Someone else with administrative rights has to do this.
members.selfRolesLocked: Your own roles can't be changed here. Someone else with administrative rights has to do this.

members.notMatchingFilter: The selected person doesn't match the search and filter.

moveDialog.descriptionWithoutSource: {name} is assigned to {to}. The change takes effect immediately, assigned roles remain in place.

settings.title: Operational defaults
settings.hint: These values apply to this organization and to every sub-unit that has not set its own. Without an own value a sub-unit follows its parent organization, all the way up to the instance default.
settings.readOnlyNotice: You can view these defaults but not change them.
settings.waterDemandHint: Feeds the demand calculation of every watering group and decides how many groups a route plan puts into one trip. Watering plans that already exist stay as they are.
settings.justWateredTtlHint: How long a tree counts as just watered after a finished watering plan before it falls back to unknown.
settings.dormantOwnValue: The own value of {value} lies dormant while the lock applies.
settings.enforcedNotice: {name} has locked the defaults for this organization. The values from there apply and cannot be overridden here.
settings.enforcedNoticeUnknown: A parent organization has locked the defaults for this organization. The values from there apply and cannot be overridden here.
settings.descendantsLabel: Sub-units may set their own values
settings.descendantsHintOn: A sub-unit that sets none keeps following what is set here.
settings.descendantsHintOff: These defaults are binding for every sub-unit. The section is read-only there.
settings.loadErrorForbidden: You aren't allowed to view this organization's defaults. Your role probably only applies to a sub-organization.
settings.loadErrorGeneric: The defaults could not be loaded. Please try again later.

toast.saveFailed: The settings could not be saved.
toast.lockedByAncestor: A parent organization has locked these settings.
